details: The overall cryptocurrency market capitalization experienced a decline of 1.24% following military strikes by the United States against Iran. This geopolitical event led to a rise in oil prices, prompting investors to pull away from riskier assets, with both Bitcoin (BTC) and Ethereum (ETH) trading lower.
title: Crypto Market Dips as Geopolitical Tensions Escalate in Middle East

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has outlined a comprehensive regulatory agenda for 2026, featuring proposals to amend rules concerning crypto asset offerings, custody for broker-dealers, and market structure for trading on alternative trading systems (ATS). This move aims to provide clearer guidelines for the digital asset industry.
title: SEC Unveils Extensive 2026 Regulatory Agenda for Crypto Markets

details: Coinbase has obtained an investment services license from the UK's Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), enabling the exchange to expand its offerings beyond cryptocurrencies to include derivatives and equities trading for institutional and advanced traders. Retail users in the UK will also gain access to equity trading on the platform.
title: Coinbase Secures UK License to Offer Stocks and Derivatives

details: Ripple has secured full Crypto-Asset Service Provider (CASP) authorization under the European Union's Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation from Luxembourg's financial regulator. This approval grants Ripple the ability to offer regulated crypto payment services across all 30 countries within the European Economic Area (EEA).
title: Ripple Achieves Full MiCA Compliance, Expands EU Crypto Services

details: Michael Saylor's MicroStrategy (Strategy) sold 3,588 BTC for approximately $216 million to cover dividend payments for its preferred stock. This marks a shift in the company's long-standing accumulation-only strategy and reflects its use of Bitcoin holdings to manage financial obligations.
title: MicroStrategy Sells Bitcoin to Fund Dividend Payments

details: The market capitalization of major stablecoins, including USDC and USDT, has decreased over the past 30 days. This trend indicates a continuous tightening of liquidity within the cryptocurrency market, a pattern that has been observed since November 2025.
title: Stablecoin Market Cap Declines, Signifying Tightening Crypto Liquidity

details: Bitcoin miners are experiencing significant financial pressure, with the Miner Cycle Stress Composite indicator falling to a new low in 2026. This suggests that roughly 20% of miners are currently operating at a loss, a level of stress historically observed near major Bitcoin market bottoms.
title: Bitcoin Miner Stress Reaches 'Historically Rare' Levels
